seo.title: Privacy Policy · Snappsense
seo.description: How Snappsense handles data: no accounts, no cookies, anonymous analytics, reports kept for 6 hours.

children.text: Last updated 11 October 2026
Snappsense analyses public app reviews. You don’t need an account, and we don’t ask for your name, email or any other personal details to use it.
What we collect
The app links you analyse.
We use them to fetch that app’s public reviews and build your report.
Basic, anonymous usage statistics.
Page views, country and device type, collected with Vercel Web Analytics. It uses no cookies and doesn’t identify you or follow you across sites.
Feedback you choose to send
through “Give feedback”: your rating and message, nothing else.
Standard server logs.
Our hosting providers keep short-lived technical logs (such as IP address and request time) to keep the service running and secure.
Reviews we process

Reports are built from reviews that are already public on Google Play and the App Store. We store a finished report for up to 6 hours so repeat visits load instantly, then it’s discarded. We don’t sell, share or build profiles from review data.
Cookies
Snappsense doesn’t set cookies and doesn’t store anything in your browser.
Who processes data for us
Vercel: hosts the website and provides the anonymous analytics.
Render: hosts the analysis server.
Sanity: hosts the site’s editable content.
Google Play and Apple App Store: the sources of the public reviews.
Your choices
Because we don’t hold accounts or personal profiles, there is usually nothing to delete. You can block analytics with any standard content blocker without affecting how Snappsense works.
Changes
If this policy changes, we’ll update the date at the top of this page.

seo.title: Terms of Use · Snappsense
seo.description: The terms for using Snappsense, the free app review analysis tool.

children.text: Last updated 11 October 2026
By using Snappsense you agree to these terms. If you don’t agree, please don’t use the service.
The service

Snappsense fetches public reviews for an app you choose and summarises them automatically: sentiment, recurring issues, priorities and suggested fixes. It is provided free of charge, as is, and may change or be unavailable at any time.
Automated results
Reports are generated by software from public reviews. They can be incomplete or wrong. Use them as a starting point, and check important decisions against your own data.
Fair use
Don’t overload the service, scrape it automatically, or try to get around its limits.
Don’t use it for anything unlawful, or to harass the people who wrote reviews.
Don’t copy, resell or rebuild Snappsense, its design or its code.
Content and trademarks

Reviews belong to their authors and the stores that publish them. Google Play is a trademark of Google LLC; App Store is a trademark of Apple Inc. Snappsense is not affiliated with or endorsed by either. The Snappsense name, logo, design and software are our property and all rights are reserved.
Liability
To the extent the law allows, Snappsense is not liable for any loss arising from using the service or relying on its reports.
Changes
We may update these terms. Continuing to use Snappsense after an update means you accept the new terms.
